summary_md:
# Vil verdens største børsnotering atter sætte danske aktier i skyggen?

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-19  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben episode. The panel sees Danish quality stocks recovering as C25 nears a double-digit annual return, helped by companies beating cautious guidance and by sector rotation out of tech and AI. Anthropic's record IPO, oversubscribed and priced at $83, is framed as a test of AI sentiment, alongside Leo Pharma's postponed IPO and the risk of a Fed hike in December. Lars Hytting (Artoscope) is constructive long-term on NKT, GN Store Nord, Novo, DSV, Lundbeck, Carlsberg, Vestas and Ørsted. He has rotated an overweight in Demant into DSV.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Lars likes NKT as a long-term electrification case at ~828 after a pullback from 1000-1100. Guidance is in the upper range.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) sees room for investor upside at current levels after the stock fell from highs. NKT is positioned for electrification, data centres and the green transition. He looks past a soft quarter (revenue slightly low, margin beat). Jacob calls it a super good play but notes revenue fell and PR spin.

#### Sell Triggers

- if high-voltage activity keeps declining
- if guidance is cut
- if electrification demand slows

> *"Jamen, jeg kan godt lide NQT. Altså, det er en god langsigtet case."*

---

### 🟢 GN — GN Store Nord | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Lars is a long-term holder: Hearing sale, cash pile, DKK 4bn buybacks in 2027, upbeat call, CMD in February. Jacob says watch, falling knife.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) is constructive after the divestment of Hearing to Amplifon. Good product launches in Enterprise and gaming, buybacks and the Nations Benefits stake are undervalued. Jacob (guest) is more cautious: the stock is 80% off its peak, so watch it long-term rather than catch a falling knife.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the February CMD lacks a credible plan
- if organic growth stays ~2%
- if buybacks are not executed

> *"værdierne begynder at komme frem, jeg tror nu nok, at det skal gå fint."*

---

### 🟢 DSV — DSV | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Artoscope moved its Demant overweight into DSV before the report because pessimism was excessive. Lars has big belief in DSV.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) bought because the stock was oversold amid problems in road freight. A JP Morgan bearish note marked peak pessimism. Expectations were so low that an ordinary report re-rated the stock. He lists DSV among his best buy ideas.

#### Sell Triggers

- if road division problems persist
- if growth disappoints even low expectations

> *"Så vi tog vores overvægt af demandt og smed den ind i DSV i stedet for."*

---

### 🟡 DEMANT — Demant | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Artoscope sold its overweight after ~70% gains. Lars expects steady state, not a repeat, now that expectations are high.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) praised execution (Seal, Reveal) but trimmed the overweight. After the strong run, expectations are elevated and must now be delivered. He does not expect another 70% year.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Reveal launch underdelivers
- if guidance misses elevated expectations

> *"vi havde en markant overvægt i demand, som vi har solgt ud her for nylig."*

---

### 🟢 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Lars holds a large long-term position. Analysts are too pessimistic and low-dose weight loss of 21-22% is good.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) explicitly backs Novo with a large position 'in the drawer' as a decidedly long-term case. He thinks the market has written it off, with near-zero sales expectations. The recovery will take time.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new product sales disappoint
- if patent expiry concerns intensify

> *"Vi tror på Novo, og vi har haft købt en ordentlig stakke aktie, som vi har smidt i skuffen."*

---

### 🟡 HLUN-B — Lundbeck | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Artoscope holds it after a strong report and upgrade. The migraine drug is outperforming, and the 2029 patent concern is parked for now.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) says Lundbeck is in a comfortable place, raking in cash from the migraine and schizophrenia drugs. Lars Rebien Sørensen as chair adds interest. The patent cliff is a longer-term issue for management.

#### Sell Triggers

- if 2029 patent expiry worries resurface
- if migraine drug growth slows

> *"Ja, vi har Lundbæk."*

---

### 🟠 FLS — FLSmidth | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

The CFO departed the day before the CMD amid messy communication. Lars sees uncertainty around execution of the new strategy.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) calls the communication messy and doesn't buy the official explanation. Without a CFO, there is uncertainty around delivering the new strategy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if further management turnover
- if the strategy is not executed

> *"det er i hvert fald uheldigt at skifte sin CFO ud dagen inden kapitalmarkedsdagen."*

---

### 🟢 CARL-B — Carlsberg | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars names Carlsberg among his best buy opportunities as a defensive play.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) mentioned it briefly when asked for the best buys: well placed in a more defensive game.

#### Sell Triggers

- if consumer demand weakens

> *"Jeg synes, Carlsberg befinder sig et godt sted i et lidt mere defensivt spil."*

---

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars says Vestas is out of a dark tunnel and heading to better times. The world needs electricity.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) names it among his best buy opportunities, a green darling after years of trouble now on a recovery path.

#### Sell Triggers

- if order intake or margins deteriorate

> *"Og jeg tror nu nok, at det skal gå fint for Vestas."*

---

### 🟠 ORSTED — Ørsted | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

A decent Q3 may have sown seeds of a comeback after a long period of winding down.

#### Reasoning

Lars (guest) is speculative: a comeback could come if projects restart.

#### Sell Triggers

- if more project cancellations or impairments

> *"men et fornuftigt Q3 kan jeg måske så nogle frø her, og det kunne godt blive spændende"*

---

### 🟠 PANW — Palo Alto Networks | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Beat and raise, stock up 10%. Jacob says cybersecurity is a very relevant play after the wave of hacks.

#### Reasoning

Jacob (guest) sees cybersecurity as a trend worth following. Palo Alto has a strong track record (+100-150% over the last year). Lars says the area is one to begin looking into.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth decelerates
- if valuation becomes stretched

> *"så jeg synes, det er helt vildt relevant at kigge ind i."*

---
